status_rule: OPEN is not a failure report; no gate is accepted without matching pinned evidence. Prepared Redis results do not satisfy Valkey or PostgreSQL gates.

gates.name: Server starts
gates.acceptance: Pinned unchanged Linux ARM64 executable reaches readiness; record binary and image digests.

gates.name: PING
gates.acceptance: Protocol response is correct; startup/loading is handled explicitly.

gates.name: SET / GET
gates.acceptance: Values and missing-key behavior match the reference.

gates.name: Concurrent clients
gates.acceptance: Concurrent reads/writes and atomic operations retain the expected results.

gates.name: Sustained workload
gates.acceptance: A predefined duration, dataset and concurrency complete within declared resource limits.

gates.name: SAVE
gates.acceptance: Synchronous snapshot completes and restores the expected dataset.

gates.name: BGSAVE
gates.acceptance: Background snapshot validates fork/COW, continued parent writes, child completion, wait/signals and restored contents.

gates.name: AOF
gates.acceptance: Declared append/fsync policy persists acknowledged writes across the specified restart scenarios.

gates.name: AOF rewrite
gates.acceptance: Background rewrite with concurrent writes produces a valid recoverable dataset.

gates.name: Graceful shutdown
gates.acceptance: Guest shutdown completes within the deadline with expected persistence and released resources.

gates.name: Forced crash
gates.acceptance: Terminate during the pinned write workload; capture acknowledged operations and files for recovery.

gates.name: Restart + persistence validation
gates.acceptance: Recover after V10 and validate contents against the declared durability policy; no named-application semantic branches.

gates.name: postgres --version
gates.acceptance: Pinned unchanged Linux ARM64 executable returns the expected version and exit status.

gates.name: initdb
gates.acceptance: Initialization completes with valid catalog/data files and no hidden fixture substitutions.

gates.name: Server startup
gates.acceptance: The initialized server reaches readiness with required background processes.

gates.name: Single connection
gates.acceptance: A real client connects and completes a query.

gates.name: CRUD
gates.acceptance: Create/read/update/delete and transaction commit/rollback produce expected results.

gates.name: Concurrent backends
gates.acceptance: Independent sessions and transactions run without cross-process state corruption.

gates.name: Shared-memory workloads
gates.acceptance: Exercise shared state and inter-process synchronization under pinned contention.

gates.name: WAL behavior
gates.acceptance: Validate WAL and acknowledged commits under the declared durability settings.

gates.name: Checkpoint
gates.acceptance: Checkpoint while active workloads run; verify subsequent restart.

gates.name: Forced crash during writes
gates.acceptance: Crash at recorded write/checkpoint phases and retain the acknowledgement oracle.

gates.name: WAL recovery
gates.acceptance: Restart from P9 without manual repair and recover according to the declared guarantees.

gates.name: Checksum/data validation
gates.acceptance: Check recovered contents and enabled checksum/integrity mechanisms; report lost or unexpected committed data.

gates.name: Long-running stress test
gates.acceptance: A pinned duration/load includes concurrent operations, resource observations and recovery; all preceding gates hold.
